entries.original: The TUI now supports modal Vim editing in the composer, including `/vim`, default-mode config, and Vim-specific keymap contexts. (#18595)
entries.translated: TUI에서 며칠에 걸친 목표 기간의 형식 지정

entries.original: TUI workflows are easier to resume and copy from with a redesigned resume/fork picker, raw scrollback mode, `/ide` context injection, and workspace-aware `/diff`. (#20065, #20819, #20294, #21001)
entries.translated: 활성 테마를 기반으로 TUI 상태 표시줄 색상 적용

entries.original: The status line can show theme-aware colors plus optional PR and branch-change summaries, and `/keymap debug` helps inspect terminal key events. (#19631, #20892, #20794)
entries.translated: 인증 변경 시 원격 플러그인 캐시 갱신

entries.original: Plugin management now supports workspace sharing, share access controls, source filtering, local share path tracking, marketplace removal/upgrades, remote bundle sync, and admin-disabled status handling. (#20278, #21124, #21419, #20560, #19843, #20478, #20268, #20298)
entries.translated: 원격 플러그인 스킬 읽기 API 추가

entries.original: Hooks can be browsed and toggled from `/hooks`, can run before/after compaction, and can add `PreToolUse` context; Codex Apps auth and eligible MCP elicitations now surface through TUI/Guardian flows. (#19882, #19905, #20692, #19193, #19431)
entries.translated: 공유 플러그인의 로컬 경로 추적

entries.original: Experimental goals are now discoverable, stay paused across resume unless the user opts back in, and show clearer validation and multi-day duration output. (#20083, #20790, #20746, #20558)
entries.translated: 기억(memories) 편집 허용

entries.original: `/copy` works better in tmux, Alt+Enter and modified Delete/Backspace keys behave correctly, and Windows typing/paste latency was reduced. (#20207, #20535, #21058, #18914)
entries.translated: 임시(ad-hoc) 지침 추가

entries.original: Large paste placeholders and Ctrl+C-stashed drafts now survive clear/editor workflows without corrupting draft history. (#21091, #21190, #21351, #21397)
entries.translated: 기억하기(remember) 프롬프트 개선

entries.original: TUI startup and accessibility were tightened by bounding terminal probes, clearing the first inline viewport render, and honoring `animations = false` for live rows. (#20654, #21450, #20564)
entries.translated: 임시 메모리 확장 지침 초기 데이터(seed) 추가

entries.original: Linux sandbox startup is more reliable across older `bwrap`, slow mount probes, symlink-protected paths, and shared `/tmp` setups. (#20628, #20111, #21127, #21234)
entries.translated: 유효한 설정 잠금(config locks) 내보내기 및 재생 기능

entries.original: Windows sandbox and exec policy now handle named pipes, ConPTY teardown, PowerShell-wrapped allow rules, worktree `safe.directory`, and unsafe Git options more reliably. (#20270, #20685, #20336, #21409, #21275)
entries.translated: `apply-patch` 파일 변경 사항을 턴 항목(turn items)으로 이동

entries.original: Fixed custom CA login behind TLS-inspecting proxies, Bedrock runtime endpoint reporting, dangerous project config keys, heredoc redirect approval matching, and unbounded MCP/hook output growth. (#20676, #20275, #20098, #20113, #20260, #21069)
entries.translated: 스크린 리더 사용 시 `animations = false` 강제 적용

entries.original: Updated the embedded OpenAI Docs sample skill so API-key setup guidance stays aligned with other docs variants. (#21263)
entries.translated: 도구 미사용 시 목표 지속 억제 기능 제거

entries.original: Documented how generated git commit attribution is gated by `codex_git_commit` and configured in `config.toml`. (#21379)
entries.translated: `cargo deny` 관련 수정

entries.original: Removed local-only planning/spec docs and redirected config docs toward the maintained external documentation surface. (#20896)
entries.translated: `app-server`: 전송(transport) 계층을 전용

entries.original: Linux releases now build, publish, bundle, and verify a standalone `bwrap` fallback for npm and DotSlash installs. (#21255, #21256, #21257, #21312, #21285)
entries.translated: Linux releases now build, publish, bundle, and verify a standalone `bwrap` fallback for npm and DotSlash installs. (#21255, #21256, #21257, #21312, #21285)

entries.original: Vendored Bubblewrap was updated to 0.11.2, including upstream security changes around setuid support. (#21389)
entries.translated: Vendored Bubblewrap was updated to 0.11.2, including upstream security changes around setuid support. (#21389)

entries.original: Windows Bazel CI now uses faster cross-compilation for tests, clippy, and release-build checks, and Bazel now runs sharded Rust integration tests. (#20585, #20701, #21057)
entries.translated: Windows Bazel CI now uses faster cross-compilation for tests, clippy, and release-build checks, and Bazel now runs sharded Rust integration tests. (#20585, #20701, #21057)
